source.title: Evaluation of hydrogen sensors and location inside a metering cabinet

claim_boundary: This is report-level contextual evidence from an actual-hydrogen metering-cabinet study. It may support cautious explanations about buoyancy, cabinet ventilation and the need to evaluate detector placement, but it has no rights-cleared raw time series or machine-readable three-dimensional coordinates. The cabinet geometry and site-specific alarm recommendation must not be transferred to a hydrogen refuelling station, used to calibrate thresholds, or presented as independent validation.
